name: lore
description: Write articles and quizzes into your private Lore knowledge inbox from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Lore is a private knowledge inbox that ChatGPT fills for you. Connect your own Lore account to list, search and open your articles; write new learning or news articles with cited sources; add quiz questions to each article; organize tags; archive articles; check which topics you keep missing; and publish a day's batch so it appears in the Lore iPhone app. The newest articles can be shown as a compact card.

Lore only reads and writes your own articles, quizzes and tags. It does not access your email, calendar, files or chat history, and it cannot send messages to anyone. Publishing a batch may send one private notification to your own iPhone.

Sign in with the same account you use in the Lore iOS app.
defaultPrompt: Write today's Lore article about how vaccines train the immune system, with three quiz questions.
Which Lore quiz topics am I weakest at?

positive.expected_behavior: Lists the review account's newest articles in a compact Lore card with each article's type (Learning or News) and edition date.

positive.prompt: Do I already have a Lore article about photosynthesis?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the user's articles for photosynthesis and answers whether a matching article exists, naming it if found.

positive.description: Write and publish an article with a quiz.
positive.prompt: Write today's Lore article about how vaccines train the immune system, with three quiz questions, and publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens today's batch, saves one learning article with cited sources, adds three quiz questions for it, then publishes the batch and confirms it is in the Lore app.

positive.prompt: Which Lore quiz topics am I weakest at?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the questions or articles the user has answered incorrectly or not yet reviewed.

positive.prompt: Is my Lore connection working, and is my plan active?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that the account is connected and whether Lore Pro is active.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Tokyo tomorrow?
Show me my coworker Tanaka's Lore articles.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything, show plans, or link to purchase pages.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: list, search and open articles; write articles with sources and quizzes; organize tags; review weak topics; publish a day's batch; show the newest articles as a card.

ja-JP.subtitle: AI が書く、あなたの知識の受け皿
ja-JP.description: ChatGPT が調べて書いた記事とクイズを、あなたの Lore に届けます。記事の一覧・検索・作成、クイズの追加、苦手な問題の確認ができます。
